comment: Per MASTER2 LLM.md — bash permitted for git/ruby/bundle invocations only. All other shell ops use zsh. rbenv is allowed so Rails/MASTER commands can honor the repository's .ruby-version. vm23 ssh/curl deliberately NOT here: settings.local.json already grants Bash(ssh *) personally, and this file is committed — production access belongs in a per-operator file, not one that ships to whoever clones.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */RAILS/*.scss) ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && ruby "$ROOT/MASTER/tools/rails/build_all_css.rb";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */MASTER/web/public/face.part*.txt|*/MASTER/web/public/face_speech_*.js) ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cd "$ROOT/MASTER/web" && rbenv exec bundle exec rails assets:build_face_runtime;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
